name: Change Ledger
description: Propose → risk-scan → review → decide. Every agent behavior change ships with a review trail: append-only, hash-chained entries, Ed25519 publish seal, zero-trust verifier.
tagline: Governed pipeline for agent behavior changes
caption: Change Ledger — Governed pipeline for agent behavior changes. Paste a before/after, get heuristic risk flags, record the decision — then verify any published ledger yourself with the zero-trust checker.
cta: Put your next behavior change on the ledger
honest_limits: Advisory review trail, not a sandbox. Risk flags are regex heuristics — they miss novel attacks and can false-positive. Verify any published ledger with node verify.js, never on trust.
